blocks.text: Add a unique home spirit with DrupCo’s New York city pillow cover! Show your love for New York and add a home spirit with this vibrant splash of New York decor! Here’s why you’ll love everything about this well-made New York throw pillow cover: -Linen and polyester fabric blend that’s low maintenance and easy to wash; New York pillow cover that has a light and bright vibe that’s complementary to any home, apartment, or deck; -A perfect choice to give as a New York-themed gift for women, men, and children! Made with durable fabric, a heavy-duty hidden zipper, and reinforced sewing — all to give you a New York-themed pillow cover that will last for a long time! -The vibrant colors and threading on our state pillows won’t fade even with multiple washes; -Its complimentary colors will allow you to mix and match it in any space or decor easily. -Artwork that’s designed by talented artists will give you a chance to play with different elements and textures to visually enhance any room. NOTE: Wash in cold water to maintain its vivid colors Click Add to Cart to get your New York pillow cover today and liven up your space right away!

items: NEW YORK THROW PILLOW COVER – Our New York city throw pillow is the ideal decor to compliment your home, apartment, or room. You can place our New York throw pillow in any room or area to add a unique state accent and show your love for New York.

DURABLE, THICK & PREMIUM FABRIC | SOFT TEXTURE – DrupsCo’s New York pillow case is made of eco-friendly cotton linen and polyester blend to make a high-quality pillowcase that is durable and soft at the same time.

BRIGHT & VIBRANT COLORS – During the production of our New York pillows we use the latest printing technology and materials that give the most vivid colors and prevent the color from fading at the same time. Whether you want to go for a vintage or modern design, our New York pillow cover adds beauty and home state spirit to any room.

EXCELLENT WORKMANSHIP | STURDY SEAMS – Our New York pillows are meticulously sewn with high-quality threads using the latest machinery so they won’t rip or tear like other cheaply-made pillow covers. DrupCo’s New York pillow cover features a heavy-duty, hidden zipper that allows for easily inserting and removing the pillow of your choice.

EASY CLEAN | MACHINE WASHABLE – You can easily throw your New York pillow case in a machine without worrying about it losing its vivid colors. The 18 x 18-inch throw pillowcases are perfect to give as a housewarming gift, birthday gift or celebratory gift for the die-hard New Yorkers.
